relationships.subject: NOP receptor
relationships.object: spinogenesis in adult-born dentate gyrus neurons
relationships.evidence_quote: spine density in 4-week-old adult-born DG neurons increased following conditional NOP Receptor KO in the DG

key_findings: NOP receptor loss in mature DG neurons increases stubby/thin spine density of adult-born neurons indirectly.
NOP antagonist SB-612,111 prevents corticosterone-induced spine loss in immature DG neurons.
